title: Adaptive-v3 board evaluation
scope: Completed existing-record measurements, with firmware images and stages separate. No publication had occurred at the evaluation checkpoint; this is a later privacy-reviewed public export. Includes the completed final recovered-v2 smoke.
limits: Four weak-source or eight strong-source temporal pairs per gain do not establish calibrated sensitivity or general RF superiority. Physical placement and stability were unmeasured and unverified, including earlier records labeled untouched.
Paired t intervals are descriptive normal-difference approximations, unadjusted for multiple comparisons; exact sign flips require exchangeability.
Sequential v2, v3 keep1, v3 keep3 image/run order confounds policy with time/drift; keep3 also changes crop aperture/retention.
Nominal RF duty is summed N/fs divided by local or host wall time, not continuous coverage. Acquisition timing overlaps processing and must not be summed.
UART transport CRC is not Nordic packet CRC. Candidate windows and selected crops are not packet recall.
Selected waveform endpoint frequency is selection-biased, not whole-run clipping or calibrated distortion.

SDK supports automatic calibration refresh, but its actual trigger and timing were not recorded. Calibration change is an additional RF-comparison confounder. Byte-for-byte NVS preservation is not established.

strong_source_plan.scope: Engineering extension, not a confirmatory power-calculated study
strong_source_plan.primary_exploratory_retention_endpoint: Per ON run, whether any retained buffer contains a complete known-address, known-payload packet with verified over-air CRC under the same conservative decoder. Missing bits do not count as CRC failures. Report by gain and image/retention separately.
secondary_endpoints: source ON minus OFF candidate windows per local second, exact within-image paired sign-flip uncertainty
nominal RF duty and CPU timing terms
raw known-packet source attribution against OFF and offset controls
limits: Configured transmit power is not calibrated received power or sensitivity.
No measured or independently verified physical geometry.
Firmware/retention phases sequential, not randomized or simultaneous; time drift and selection remain confounders.
Transport CRC differs from over-air packet CRC.
No packet-recall estimate from transmitter counts or selected buffers.

verification_scope: Zero failed completed acquisition/pipeline runs does not imply an issue-free evaluation. Tie-retention defect, initial preflight correction, high-baud backup transfer failures and NVS byte-preservation discrepancy were real findings.
